title.en: An Act Converting Gil Fernando Avenue in Barangays Sto. Niño and San Roque, City of Marikina Into a National Road
title.orig: An Act Converting Gil Fernando Avenue in Barangays Sto. Niño and San Roque, City of Marikina Into a National Road

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2010/ra_10079_2010.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Gil Fernando Avenue in barangays Sto. Niño and San Roque, City of Marikina is hereby converted into a national road.
The Secretary of the Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
